mapper.select: SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) AS attachment_count, SUM(attachment_type IN ('IMAGE','SCREENSHOT','ANNOTATED_SCREENSHOT')) AS screenshot_count, SUM(attachment_type='LOG') AS log_count, SUM(attachment_type IN ('VIDEO','SCREEN_RECORDING')) AS video_count, MAX(created_at) AS updated_at FROM t_feedback_attachment WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND source_id IN #{sourceId} GROUP BY source_id
